paras: A bed with storage gives you space for blankets, pillows and clothes without needing more furniture in the room. Our double bed is built to fit a 160 × 200 cm mattress, and we can change the size if your mattress is different.

Mattress sizes are not the same everywhere, so we always ask you to measure your mattress or send us a photo before we start. You can also choose the headboard style, wood tone and finish. If you want a full bed set, tell us about the dressing table and side tables you need and we will plan them to match.
faq: Can you make a king or single size bed?
Yes. Send us your mattress size and we will build the bed to fit it.
Can I get a matching bed set?
Yes. Tell us which pieces you want, such as a dressing table and side tables, and we will plan them to match your bed.
